reasons: Wrong quantity: the Datadog query is postgresql.rows_returned (rows returned by queries), but the candidate uses postgresql.tup_updated, which counts rows updated.

The candidate translates to a different metric instead of mapping rows_returned to an OTel metric that measures the same quantity; no OTel definition for rows_returned was supplied, so the expected outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING unless a true equivalent is confirmed.
Unit and aggregation are carried over from the wrong metric, so the series are not the same as the Datadog request even though the avg(rate(...)) shape looks plausible.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct; this does not change the verdict.
